description: Account-wide feed of completed checks, newest first, each already carrying its monitor (name + URL), the AI summary of what changed, and the extracted output. This is the tool to use for reporting questions — 'what changed this week?', 'summarise my monitors', 'which pages moved?' — because it answers them in ONE call. Do not loop get_check_history over every monitor for that. Defaults to alerts only; set alertedOnly false to include no-change runs as a data feed. pageAccess says what the browser reached; when reachedContent is false the check saw a challenge, login or error page, so report that, not a change in content.

alertedOnly.description: true (default) returns only checks that detected a change and alerted; false returns every completed check

from.description: ISO date lower bound, inclusive — e.g. last week's date for a weekly report

includeHidden.description: Include changes the user hid (hide_change). Default false.

monitorUuid.description: Restrict to a single monitor (from list_monitors)

status.description: Explicit status filter: ALERT_SENT, CHANGE, NO_CHANGE or ERROR. Ignored when alertedOnly is true.

name: get_recent_changes
title: Get recent changes across all monitors
